title: Corn Cacio y Pepe
description: A summer flavored corn forward cacio y Pepe inspired dish. Goes great over pasta. Could also work as a dip.
steps: Blend approximately half of the corn with water
Toast other half of the corn. Some char is good
The finer the strain, the smoother the sauce.
When the corn is toasted, add the purée
Add the pepper and Parmesan to the corn mix.
Add the pasta and some pasta water to pan
Mix and serve. Add more water to desired consistency
